architecture.value: Transformer decoder (Radford et al. 2019 modifications); J1-Jumbo 76 layers

source.quote:
We based our models on the decoder module of the Transformer architecture (Vaswani et al., 2017) with the modifications
proposed by Radford et al. (2019).

trainingData.value: 300B tokens from publicly available resources (structure similar to GPT-3 training data)

source.quote:
Our model was trained with the conventional self-supervised auto-regressive training objective on 300B tokens drawn
from publicly available resources, attempting, in part, to replicate the structure of the training data as reported in Brown

topics.headline: Jurassic-1 models are marginally less biased than GPT3 on [StereoSet](/evals/stereoset) (Overall ICAT J1-Jumbo 68.3)

source.quote:
While it appears the Jurassic-1 models are
marginally less biased than GPT3, this is merely one benchmark and we do not wish to overstate our claims.

findings.text: The authors state Jurassic-1 absorbs training-data bias and toxicity and can replicate them, like other language models.

source.quote:
language models absorb biases and toxicity expressed in
the texts they were trained on, and are prone to replicating them. Our model is no different

findings.text: They recommend prompt engineering and filtering of suspected results to mitigate bias harms, while noting the problem is unsolved.

source.quote:
Many methods could be
used to mitigate these issues, e.g., by carefully engineering prompts, or filtering suspected results – which we strongly
recommend users of our models to adopt

findings.text: AI21 invites ethics and safety collaboration via safety@ai21.com.

source.quote:
We invite anyone
interested in conducting research on or otherwise promoting AI ethics and safety to contact us at safety@ai21.com and
explore opportunities for collaboration.

notes: Technical report / white paper (not a system card). Only safety eval is StereoSet bias (Table 7); toxicity is discussed qualitatively with no toxicity benchmark scores. Skipped capability: Table 4 log-prob per byte, Table 5 format sensitivity, Table 6 zero-shot (ARC, BoolQ, HellaSwag, PIQA, RACE, RTE, StoryCloze, Winogrande), Figure 2 few-shot DBPedia-14 and TREC-6. Seed links only ai21/j1-jumbo; J1-Large (7.5B) has no separate seed id (seed api alias j1-large maps to Jumbo), so covers uses rawModelName. Curie/Davinci left as rawModelName. Abstract says J1-Large 7B; Table 1 says 7.5B. No risk framework or external safety testers. Footnote mentions 800 GPUs over months but no FLOPs, so trainingCompute not_stated.
